title: Kubernetes & Orchestration
intro: Kubernetes interviews test whether you understand the declarative model, not just kubectl. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with Kubernetes fundamentals (the control plane, pods, the reconcilation loop), then workloads (Deployments, StatefulSets, Jobs), then networking (Services, Ingress, CNI) and configuration (ConfigMaps, Secrets). Helm follows at the applied tier, then scaling (HPA, VPA, cluster autoscaler). It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
